## DryRun meetings API
The web app reads your meetings and briefs from the DryRun meetings table, with each meeting's rehearsals from DryRun sessions and its attendees' twins from DryRun people: GET /webhook/dryrun/meetings, GET /webhook/dryrun/meeting?id=, GET /webhook/dryrun/twin?email= and GET /webhook/dryrun/twins (docs/CONTRACT.md).
